WITH bucket_stats AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
        CASE
            WHEN count(*) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 1 AND 20) > 1071
            THEN avg(ss_ext_tax) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 1 AND 20)
            ELSE avg(ss_net_paid_inc_tax) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 1 AND 20)
        END AS bucket1,
        CASE
            WHEN count(*) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 21 AND 40) > 39161
            THEN avg(ss_ext_tax) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 21 AND 40)
            ELSE avg(ss_net_paid_inc_tax) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 21 AND 40)
        END AS bucket2,
        CASE
            WHEN count(*) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 41 AND 60) > 29434
            THEN avg(ss_ext_tax) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 41 AND 60)
            ELSE avg(ss_net_paid_inc_tax) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 41 AND 60)
        END AS bucket3,
        CASE
            WHEN count(*) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 61 AND 80) > 6568
            THEN avg(ss_ext_tax) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 61 AND 80)
            ELSE avg(ss_net_paid_inc_tax) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 61 AND 80)
        END AS bucket4,
        CASE
            WHEN count(*) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 81 AND 100) > 21216
            THEN avg(ss_ext_tax) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 81 AND 100)
            ELSE avg(ss_net_paid_inc_tax) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 81 AND 100)
        END AS bucket5
    FROM store_sales
    WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 1 AND 20
       OR ss_quantity BETWEEN 21 AND 40
       OR ss_quantity BETWEEN 41 AND 60
       OR ss_quantity BETWEEN 61 AND 80
       OR ss_quantity BETWEEN 81 AND 100
)
SELECT bucket_stats.bucket1,
       bucket_stats.bucket2,
       bucket_stats.bucket3,
       bucket_stats.bucket4,
       bucket_stats.bucket5
FROM reason
JOIN bucket_stats
  ON reason.r_reason_sk = 1
WHERE reason.r_reason_sk = 1
